trigger: July 9, night. Lou called you up the hill.

nodes.speaker: lou
nodes.text: Dell. Sit. Listen. Every net I have went quiet at 11:14. All of them at once.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Static. Then fragments: '...Minot...' '...Norfolk, say again...' '...who launched...'

nodes.speaker: lou
nodes.text: I have three stories by midnight. A federal strike on the Compact silos. A foreign strike.

nodes.speaker: lou
nodes.text: And a fellow in Manitoba says a sensor fault, then a cascade. Nobody meant it. Everybody did it.

nodes.speaker: lou
nodes.text: In the morning I go on the air. People will believe what I say. Which do I say?

choices.text: Say it was foreign. People need one enemy.

nodes.speaker: lou
nodes.text: I think in 1975 I watched a country end from a boat. Nobody on the boat knew why either.

nodes.speaker: lou
nodes.text: Knowing didn't feed anyone. But lying cost me my daughter's trust. Your call.

choices.text: Say it was foreign. People need one enemy.

nodes.speaker: lou
nodes.text: 'This is KD0LOU. Something terrible happened. We don't know what. Be kind. Weather follows.'

nodes.speaker: lou
nodes.text: ...All right. Somebody over the water. That will hold people together. For a while.

nodes.speaker: lou
nodes.text: Then Ironwood's boys hear it too. They'll desert by morning. Or they'll get angry.

nodes.speaker: lou
nodes.text: Take this. Dosimeter. Old civil defense. Clip it on your coat. Watch the needle.
